Risk: Architectural drift, context limits and lane conflicts
Evidence or cause: No memory between sessions; 700K+ lines of code; parallel worktrees edit shared code
Mitigation: ADRs, CLAUDE.md, module docs, generated code map, boundary lint, fitness tests, contract snapshots; coordinator merges in dependency order; architecture review every ~50 tasks

Risk: Subtle security bugs
Evidence or cause: Authz bypass, query-compiler injection, webhook SSRF, SAML signature wrapping, CORS mistakes and WASM escapes are easy to get subtly wrong
Mitigation: /security-review on IAM, API, IMP, EXT, AI and Builder changes; property tests and fuzzing; ASVS L2 checklist; DAST; external pen tests before 1.0 and 2.0

Risk: Tests that confirm the code rather than the spec
Evidence or cause: The same agent writes code and tests
Mitigation: Spec-ID tests written first by a separate subagent; conformance suites change only with a spec change; mutation testing; traceability coverage

Risk: Hallucinated Jira behaviour
Evidence or cause: Claude's recall of Jira may be wrong and no Atlassian account may be used to check it
Mitigation: Every spec statement cites a public source or is marked unverified; validate with design-partner exports and fidelity reports

Risk: Licence contamination from reproduced code
Evidence or cause: Model output can resemble third-party or Atlassian code; dependencies can carry incompatible licences
Mitigation: Licence allowlist in CI, SBOM, ScanCode snippet scan before releases, clean-room provenance, no copy-paste from the web

Risk: Throughput limited by budget, CI capacity or gate delays
Evidence or cause: Estimates assume steady sessions; gates, accounts and sign-offs need the owner; no Docker on the dev machine yet
Mitigation: Measure velocity in M0 and re-forecast every 100 tasks; embedded Postgres locally and containers in CI; scripted 1 to 2 hour acceptance; decisions listed with deadlines

Risk: Sustainability, trust and accountability
Evidence or cause: One owner and one AI vendor; no-paywall product must fund usage and audits; Plane, Planka and Mattermost lost trust by restricting features
Mitigation: Everything in the repo with standard tools so humans can take over; named security contact; always-free charter; optional paid support, migrations and hosting

Risk: Missing the Data Center exit window
Evidence or cause: DC expansions end 30 Mar 2028 and DC turns read-only 28 Mar 2029
Mitigation: Importer-first scope; 1.0 before Q1 2028 in every scenario; design-partner beta; DC XML import works on read-only instances

Risk: Scope sprawl
Evidence or cause: Seven products plus Marketplace categories; Huly's everything-app hosting collapse
Mitigation: Milestone gates; integrate wiki, chat and Backstage instead of rebuilding; Align and customer service deferred to M4

Risk: Performance collapse at scale
Evidence or cause: Field count was Jira's top latency driver; per-tenant Postgres hit the largest RDS size
Mitigation: Typed field storage, permission cache, partitioning, nightly 10M and weekly 30M benchmarks, visible guardrails

Risk: Atlassian legal exposure and naming
Evidence or cause: Customer Agreement s.2.2(d)-(f); Developer Terms s.6(f), 6(i); SAS v WPL; Atlassian marks; narrow patents; the codename Tracksmith appears to match an existing apparel brand
Mitigation: Clean-room protocol, no Atlassian accounts, original docs, optional compatibility modules, 'compatible with Jira' wording only, FTO review, name screening before public release, counsel review

Risk: Import fidelity and Jira API churn
Evidence or cause: Offset search removed; ADF rich text; burst limits; DC XML details only partly documented
Mitigation: Streaming DC XML parser, customer tokens, ADF preserved, resumable delta sync, fidelity reports, design-partner data

Risk: Compliance burden on self-hosters
Evidence or cause: Atlassian's certifications cover only its own cloud
Mitigation: SBOMs, signed releases, hardening guides, FIPS-mode build, control-mapping packs, published pen test summaries

Risk: Self-hosting complexity and hosts without Docker
Evidence or cause: Sentry self-hosted needs ~20 containers and 16 GB; some shared hosts and VPS images lack Docker
Mitigation: Postgres-only required state; one image; install.sh checks prerequisites and explains fixes; single-server mode; no-Docker single binary in M2

Risk: AI cost runaway on self-hosted instances
Evidence or cause: Tokens bill to the admin's key; agents and bulk jobs can loop
Mitigation: Spend caps per workspace, feature and user; usage dashboard and alerts at 80%; Batches for bulk work; task budgets; effort set per feature

Risk: AI data leak and privacy
Evidence or cause: Ticket content leaves the server when AI runs; HIPAA customers on Atlassian Cloud must switch AI off
Mitigation: AI hidden with no key; strict mode; per-track switch; field redaction; egress notice; no content in AI logs by default; keys only in the backend kit; inference_geo and cloud-account clients for residency

Risk: Prompt injection through ticket content
Evidence or cause: Agents with tools read untrusted text from tickets, comments, emails and portal requests
Mitigation: Content passed as data; per-feature tool allowlists; confirmation before writes; least-privilege agent principals; red-team suite in CI

Risk: Provider API changes and model retirement
Evidence or cause: Models and parameters change, e.g. forced tool_choice returns a 400 on claude-opus-5-5
Mitigation: One provider interface; official SDKs; live model list from the Models API; recorded-fixture contract tests plus nightly smoke tests; admin-selectable models

Risk: Cross-site cookie and auth restrictions
Evidence or cause: Browsers block third-party cookies when frontend and API sit on unrelated sites
Mitigation: Builder recommends sibling subdomains with SameSite cookies; cross-site mode uses OAuth 2.1 PKCE with short-lived bearer tokens and refresh rotation; e2e in both topologies

Risk: Version skew between frontend and backend
Evidence or cause: Frontend kits on static hosts are not rebuilt when the backend upgrades
Mitigation: Meta endpoint with minimum frontend version; N-1 API compatibility tests; update banner; admin list of registered frontends and versions; rebuild from the saved project file

Risk: DNS, HTTPS, static-host and CDN misconfiguration
Evidence or cause: Users may skip DNS records, upload to hosts without HTTPS or serve stale bundles from CDN caches
Mitigation: Kit README lists DNS records; install.sh checks DNS and certificates; frontend refuses plain HTTP except localhost; hashed asset names, no-cache index.html and purge notes in the kit

Risk: Lost setup token or kit secrets
Evidence or cause: Secrets are generated locally and exist only in the kit and the user's files
Mitigation: One-time setup token regenerable from the server console; passphrase-encrypted project file; backup includes .env secrets; documented recovery and key-rotation steps
